prompt: Band every promotion by discount_pct: depth is 'deep' for 40 or more, 'medium' for 20 or more but under 40, and 'light' for anything lower. Return promo_code and depth, one row per promotion. Any row order is fine. Which query returns it?

options.text:
SELECT promo_code,
       CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 20 THEN 'medium'
            WHEN discount_pct >= 40 THEN 'deep'
            ELSE 'light'
       END AS depth
FROM promotions

SELECT promo_code,
       CASE WHEN discount_pct > 40 THEN 'deep'
            WHEN discount_pct > 20 THEN 'medium'
            ELSE 'light'
       END AS depth
FROM promotions

SELECT promo_code,
       CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 40 THEN 'deep'
            WHEN discount_pct >= 20 THEN 'medium'
            ELSE 'light'
       END AS depth
FROM promotions

SELECT promo_code,
       CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 40 THEN 'deep'
            WHEN discount_pct >= 20 THEN 'medium'
       END AS depth
FROM promotions
